message:
The combined bucket-ladder both loosens and collects in one motion, which matters because Black Point-1 (BP-1), meaning crushed basalt lunar simulant, is high-friction and abrasive so a shallow low-angle cut stays inside traction. Plain words: the proven ladder from the A Simple Tele-Robotic Lunar Excavator (E1) mined 8 kg in 1 min, in the class of the winning rover in the University of Virginia Students Win NASA Challenge With Excavation Rover (E2), and the blade method from the INFRASTRUCTURE ROBOTICS: A TECHNOLOGY ENABLER (E5) and the Preparation of Papers for AIAA Technical Conferences (E6) gives only about a small bag of soil in push force and about two minutes per trip, from the cut-force estimate (E9) at 32.9 N and the fill simulation (E11) at 112 s to 15 kg; 32.9 N is about 3 kg weight against a 60 kg robot, so everyday scale says traction margin is comfortable.

The steep wedge hopper plus rear-pivot dump hold and empty the load, which matters because BP-1 arches and will not pour from shallow boxes. Plain words: mass flow needs steep smooth walls and a large outlet from the Case Study - Limestone and Clay Storage Solution | Jenike & Johanson (E7) and the Powder Perspectives: There is a Science to Powder Handling (E8), applied to compacted density between 1.5 g/cm3 and 1.8 g/cm3 from the Robotics Minindg Competition Rules 2014 1 - [PDF Document] (E4) with peak friction 39 deg to 51 deg from the Developing a New Space Economy (2019) 5068.pdf Lightning Talk or Poster (E3), so a 20 L wedge holds about half a person's weight and we plan half-full trips with shaking to break arches, from the payload mass (E10) at 30.0 kg max and the side-view dump sketch (E13).

The fallback drag scraper with a replaceable edge keeps the mission alive if the chain jams, and sets interfaces for others: Mobility and Deployable Chassis Lead please check tip-over and bin-lip clearance for the raised pour, Power Structure and Integration Lead please carry the hopper steel and vibrator in the 60 kg sum, and Autonomy and Blind Operations Lead please limit ladder motor current for stall and add a bin-alignment marker for unsighted dumping. Not ready, because selections and the arching plus edge-wear bench tests are still open.
